# Fixtures — S32 Design Studio · NXP S32K1xx (reserved)

![status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-reserved-lightgrey.svg)
![backend](https://img.shields.io/badge/backend-S32DS%20%C2%B7%20.mex-blue.svg)
![roadmap](https://img.shields.io/badge/roadmap-later%20stage-inactive.svg)

Placeholder for real **S32 Design Studio (ConfigTools `.mex`)** project fixtures
for the **S32K1xx** family, following the fixture layout
`tests/fixtures/nxp/<backend: ds|eb>/<family>/<project>/`.

**Reserved.** Validation currently targets S32K3 (see [`../s32k3/`](../s32k3/)).
Add an S32K1 project here only when that family is scheduled on the
[roadmap](../../../../docs/roadmaps/rtd-config-roadmap.md); fixtures must
include the files vendor validation needs and exclude build/generated artifacts.
